tagline: Commissioner, seller of Swift, and the recipient of the memo at 67.46.
file: A commissioner who competes, and a competitor who negotiates in public. Every roster move comes with an audience.

Naming a price in the chat, then renegotiating it live. Swift for next year's 1st, Collins on the block, and Achane staying in the IR slot till next year. In Week 7 he claimed Quentin Johnston for $1 after Hades9mm cut him.
Hades9mm, who said he would out score him and did, 124.02 to 67.46.
Whether Collins moves before the deadline, C33DeezNutzz in Week 9, and the 1.03, 63.26 MAXPF points above the 1.01.
headline: 3-5, 9th, and a 67.46 he asked for
story: Week 8 was the memo. After asking the chat how embarrassing it would be to win, he scored 67.46 against Hades9mm's 124.02, with Drake Maye leading at 22.46 and 15.0 on the bench. He fell one spot to 9th at 3-5, with 950.6 points, 9th in the league. His MAXPF of 1056.38 holds the 1.03, 63.26 above Snipe58.

The price he named in the chat cleared: D'Andre Swift went to StealingGas for a 2027 1st, the first of the block listings to move. Collins is still for sale, Devin Singletary arrived without a bid, and FAAB stays at $103. He also renamed more of his roster in the chat, including Nicholas Singleton as I Made a Mistake.
takes: Asked for a low pick, sold a scorer, and scored 67.46.
A bad score does not lower MAXPF. A trade does.
